full_prompt_en: A square surreal aerial illustration looks straight down over a densely packed city whose streets frame an enormous blue eye. Small beige and gray buildings cover nearly every area of the image, their flat roofs, courtyards and tiny shadows rendered with maplike precision. Four broad roads approach the middle from the top, bottom, left and right, lined with miniature cars and narrow dark building fronts. At the center, the street pattern opens into an almond-shaped pale area. A giant eye fills that opening, its cream-white sclera outlined by dark curving edges like an eyelid pressed into the city grid. The iris is a ring of vivid blue and turquoise around a deep brown-black pupil. Fine radial strokes give the iris a translucent, almost photographic texture that contrasts with the small hard rooftops around it. The eye's inner corners taper into the surrounding roads, making the urban geometry appear to turn into anatomy. No human figure stands outside the miniature streets, and there is no readable sign or title. Bright overhead daylight clarifies rooftop planes and gives the dense city short shadows, while the eye seems evenly lit from within the central opening. The palette is mostly sandy beige, slate gray and muted brown, so the single blue iris becomes a strong focal point. The overall composition uses strict top-down symmetry and immense scale contrast to make a familiar city grid feel strangely watchful.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形超现实俯视插画笔直向下望去，密集城市的街道围出一只巨大的蓝眼。小小的米色与灰色建筑覆盖几乎全部画面，平屋顶、内院和微小阴影以地图般精确的方式描写。四条宽路从上下左右通向中部，路上有微型汽车，两边是窄深建筑正面。中央，街道图案打开成杏仁状浅色区域。一只巨眼填满开口，奶油白眼球由深色弯曲边缘围住，像眼睑压进城市网格。虹膜是围绕深褐黑瞳孔的一圈鲜蓝与青绿。纤细放射笔痕让虹膜带半透明、近似摄影的肌理，与周围小而坚硬的屋顶对照。眼睛内外眼角渐收进周围道路，使城市几何形仿佛转成解剖形态。微型街道之外没有人物，也没有可读标识或标题。明亮顶光照清屋顶平面，让密集城市带短阴影，眼睛则似在中央开口中均匀发亮。配色多数是沙米色、石板灰和压低褐色，因此唯一蓝虹膜成为强烈焦点。整体构图借严格俯视对称与巨大的尺度反差，使熟悉的城市网格显得像在异样地注视。
style_prompt_en: The aerial-surreal treatment pairs miniature top-down precision with one oversized organic focal form. Beige, stone gray and muted brown create a dense low-contrast grid, while saturated blue-turquoise concentrates inside a single central shape. Fine hard-edged detail repeats at the margins; smoother radial texture and a strong dark core make the center feel luminous and alive. Overhead light keeps cast shadows short, allowing pattern and scale to carry most depth. Several linear paths converge into the central opening, giving the otherwise crowded surface clear direction. The image feels analytical and uncanny at once, with obsessive detail serving a simple visual surprise.
style_prompt_zh: 这种俯视超现实处理把微型的顶视精确细节与一个超大有机焦点形结合。米色、石灰和压低褐色建立密而低反差的网格，饱和蓝青绿则集中于中央一处形体。细小硬边细节在外缘重复；更平滑的放射肌理和强深色核心使中心显得发亮而有生机。顶光让投影简短，图案与尺度承担大部分纵深。几条线性路径汇入中央开口，为原本拥挤的表面提供清楚方向。图像既有分析感又怪异，执拗细节服务于一个简洁的视觉意外。
theme_en: A giant blue eye set within a densely detailed city seen from directly above
theme_zh: 俯瞰密集城市，一只巨大的蓝眼嵌在街区之中
name: Bird's eye view
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
